details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an x-beacon-package header. The reported fields are limited to the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the working directory, the npm/node user agent and the URL protocol — no environment values, credentials, tokens or file contents are read or sent. index.js is a no-op Proxy shim that re-fires the same beacon when the module is imported.
